built_unverified_note: NOTHING WAS COMPILED, TESTED, LINTED OR FORMATTED. Written under the owner's 2026-11-15 instruction; the pipeline builds and tests after merge. Every test below is 'mutation: not run'. Only ./scripts/check-secrets.sh was run (see commit).

rows.what: The two generated tail worlds, the joint world and the capacity probe's seeded agent run now journal MonteCarlo SyntheticEpisodes with their seeds (cycle number; configured seed), via the new qip-kernel module synthetic_worlds and stage_simulate. A Conditional-arm test with a real causal graph was added.
rows.remains: LEARN's counterfactual twin scores are deliberately not episodes (ADR 0682 decision 3: the twin replays recorded bars, which the contract says is not synthetic) - a reviewer must accept or reject that decision. Nothing was compiled, so every test is unrun.

rows.what: qip-ledgerd now links qip-telemetry-drain, has the thin openobserve module and spawns the drain from main.rs. A new acceptance suite otlp_coverage enumerates apps/* and fails any binary that neither links the drain nor is on a committed EXPORTERLESS list (edge-node, web, cli, each with a reason).
rows.remains: qip-edge-node, qip-web and qip-cli export nothing (edge-node waits on an ADR 0116 sidecar record); no collector is configured or shown to ingest. Nothing was compiled. The earlier draft failed because its test gave a URL with no organisation; the new test supplies both and a third pins the refusal.
rows.test_command: cargo test -p qip-ledgerd --lib; cargo test -p qip-acceptance --test otlp_coverage --test manifest_wiring

rows.what: All six data objectives are declared in a new data_plane catalogue chained into evaluate_where (the 11-entry critical-path catalogue and 3-entry default_slos data set are untouched). Lineage and re-fetch health are fed (new qip_data_refetch_checks_total recorded beside the gauge); archive delay, Bigtable p99, knowledge-delta and BQ freshness are Unbuilt and say why.
rows.remains: Four objectives have no series: no process ingests a GCS archive and the Bigtable/BQ/knowledge-delta stores are not on. Their figures (10 ms p99; 300 s freshness; 0.99) are PROVISIONAL, chosen restrictive, owned by nobody. One existing test expectation changed (statuses.len() now adds data-plane objectives). Nothing was compiled.
rows.test_command: cargo test -p qip-observability --no-fail-fast; cargo test -p qip-kernel --test refetch_health_series

rows.what: Per owner ruling, the image's Binary Authorization attestation is the signature; the deep brain now refuses (Error::denied) at Operations::build a runbook set whose SHA-256 is not REVIEWED_RUNBOOK_SET_DIGEST, and a pin test fails a commit that changes the set without the digest. The ADR says the digest is not itself a signature.
rows.remains: The digest constant was computed by a script, not by running Rust: if the pin test fails on first run the constant is wrong and the failure message holds the right value. No signer, KMS or Terraform was added. Nothing was compiled.

rows.what: New qip-kernel module training_export gives one TrainingExport of every path LEARN priced (declined, cell-declined, filled, partly-unfilled), read from the replayed journal via Platform::training_export, Simulated figures kept tainted, with JSON-lines output.
rows.remains: Hedge-not-taken (owner decision 7), agency proposals (ambient door) and the individual different-hedge/different-venue arm figures are not journaled, so they cannot be exported; named in ADR 0683. Nothing was compiled.
rows.test_command: cargo test -p qip-kernel --lib training_export; cargo test -p qip-kernel --test learning
